title: Show Clinical Cohort Data at Their Best
text: Put cohort show. vernissage opening exhibition, works hung shown best. package prepares clinical cohort data shows : overview table, distributions, missing-data maps, paired visits, correlations, PCA, radar forest plots, publication theme, colour-blind safe palettes polished gt tables. Data wide format (one row per subject, one column per variable visit, names NFL_V0, NFL_V3). Preparation: French CSV import, name cleaning, visits long format, bilateral measures, robust outlier rules, log / Box-Cox transformations decided baseline applied follow-, composite scores. Description figures: describe_cohort(), plot_na_map(), plot_distribution(), plot_paired_visits(), plot_trajectories(), plot_cor_heatmap(), plot_pca_*(), plot_radar(), plot_forest(). Reports: number p-value formatting, gt publication tables significance highlighting, Quarto tabsets callouts. Companion packages: lodestar: limits detection cut-offs (median split, tertiles, reclassification visits); statistical modelling lives separate package.

what: Visit suffixes of variable names — visit_root
title: Visit suffixes of variable names — visit_root
text: Names follow <ROOT>_<VISIT> convention. visit_root() removes visit suffix; visit_swap() replaces one visit suffix another (NFL_V0 -> NFL_V3).

title: vernissage 0.1.0
text: First version, gathering preprocessing visualisation helpers analysis scripts (00_common.R, 01_preprocessing.R, 02_distribution.R, 03_descriptive.R, 04_longitudinal.R, 07_transform_outliers.R 09_radar_plot.R). limit--detection cut-functions companion package lodestar; modelling functions kept separate package; clustering functions included.

title: vernissage 0.1.0
text: describe_cohort(): overview table cohort (type, N, missing values, summaries overall group, group test, text histogram), replacing table1(), depended functions absent scripts (bilille_gt_theme(), .is_typst()). Column arguments accept character vectors, bare names tidyselect helpers. New helpers repeated code: visit_root(), visit_swap(), gt_sig_colors() (replaces constant GT_SIG_COLORS), pal_okabe_ito() (replaces object okabe_ito). pal_levels() also accepts palette name ("okabe", hcl.pals(), palette.pals(), RColorBrewer) function. outlier_flag_mad() outlier_flag_iqr() exported; outlier_flag_iqr(method = "hinges") reproduces former outliers_table() (Tukey’s hinges boxplot.stats()).

title: vernissage 0.1.0
text: transform_choose() (former choose_transformation()): failed none preferred methods computed (e.g. log impossible values <= 0); best W used. variable without Shapiro W keeps first method explicit reason instead disappearing. plot_radar(): local fmt_p() %||% masked package ones; label format (p=0.012) kept private helper. Colours come pal_levels(): groups colours, palette now interpolated instead recycled. seed, random state session restored call. plot_distribution(): identifier metadata join longer defaults cohort-specific "SampleName": id_col required metadata. visit_map_suffix(): select now required (former default "^MRI_", kept deprecated visit_suffix_map()). label_expand(): format categorised variables argument (bin_format, bin_format_root) instead global options fairpark.bin_label / fairpark.bin_label_root (still read deprecated expand_labels()). seed jitters subsamples argument (seed = 1) instead global option analysis.seed. read_cohort_csv() path_resolve_nfc(): documentation merged scripts; function now . Skewness kurtosis computed internally (moment estimators e1071::skewness(type = 1) / kurtosis(type = 1)), removes dependency e1071. Every non-ASCII character code written \u escapes, required R CMD check.
